sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Cycles through three weather phases while chipping his health down, then transforms into a harder Abomination form at 40%. 10-minute enrage. Reflects, condition cleanse, and the Forsaken Thicket Waters mastery all help.

sections.heading: Mechanics active the whole fight
bullets: <mark>Blood Shield</mark>: Matthias goes invulnerable and fires <mark>Blood Shards</mark> at you — reflect at least 18 of the 20-25 shards to strip the shield. Don't destroy or body-block them, they need to bounce back at him.

Blood Sacrifice: starting around 9:45 and repeating every 45s (until 40% health), a marked player must have their breakbar broken by the squad before they're sacrificed — they can't break it themselves.

<mark>Shards of Rage</mark>: Matthias leaps and fires a separate volley of projectiles — dodge, block, or invuln these, never reflect them. Reflecting stacks <mark>Blood Fueled</mark> on him, buffing his damage 10% per stack, up to +250%.
<mark>Corruption</mark>: every 30s a random player stacks damage and needs to reach a clean fountain. A used fountain turns red and is unusable for 1:30, so don't all rely on the same one.

sections.heading: Weather phases (100% → 40%)
bullets: Snowstorm (100-80%): chill stacks build every 10s, icy patches spawn. Watch for Oppressive Gaze — a projectile dealing 50% of max HP if it hits.
Heat Wave (80-60%): standing still stacks damage; flame tornadoes spawn. Unstable Blood Magic marks players (audio + green skull) to drop a damaging field away from the center and fountains.
Downpour (60-40%): moving stacks a debuff, 10 stacks knocks you down. Watch for Zealous Benediction — 5 targeted players get expanding red circles that instantly down anyone caught overlapping.

sections.heading: Abomination phase (40% → 0%)
bullets: Weather now cycles through all three every 30 seconds instead of by health threshold, and every mechanic above returns except Sacrifice — with changes: Spread hits everyone (not just 5), and shards fire across the room instead of from center.
New: Spirits add — they can be blocked but not dodged, so sidestep their path instead. Below 20% health, two spirits spawn at once instead of one.
Matthias has no fixed target here — he just moves toward whoever's furthest away, so positioning matters more than usual.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 — Matthias deals +200% damage past this point.
